The premise

The boring work, finally out of your head.

SEOlint was built for teams who knew SEO mattered, but did not want to become SEO people. It turned small technical signals into a steady, visible loop.

⌕

It watched quietly.

A weekly crawl spotted changes, regressions, and pages drifting out of shape.

⌘

It shipped clearly.

Every recommendation arrived as a small, reviewable pull request with context.

✦

It measured honestly.

See what moved after a fix — not just a green checklist that felt good.

A smaller SEO surface area

Make improvements once. Keep them moving.

A practical set of loops for modern product teams — designed to fit in the tools you already use.

01 / AUTOPILOT

Good SEO, on a schedule.

Set it loose on your docs, marketing pages, and changelog. SEOlint kept the low-stakes maintenance moving without another dashboard to babysit.

↗
02 / REVIEW

Changes you can trust.

Small diffs. Useful explanations. Humans stayed in the loop.

↗
03 / IMPACT

Proof, not vibes.

Connect the fix to the signal it was meant to change.

Archive / July 2026

The product ended. The useful parts remain.

SEOlint stopped operating in July 2026. We kept this small archive online to document what we learned about automation, taste, and the last mile of SEO.
